templateAuthor.localConfigurationOnly.en: This completion method can be edited and saved only on this device. Remote draft and publishing are unavailable.
templateAuthor.localConfigurationOnly.zh-Hans: 此完成方式仅支持本机编辑与保存，不能提交远端草稿或发布。

templateAuthor.preference.instructions.en: Edit the source questionnaire JSON: steps/options/scores, dimensions, tiebreak, results and tags. Keys belong to the author; nothing is automatically reordered. Invalid text can still be saved locally.
templateAuthor.preference.instructions.zh-Hans: 编辑原始题组 JSON：步骤、选项及分值、维度、并列取舍题、结果和标签。key 由作者维护，不自动重排。格式错误的文本也可保存本地。

templateAuthor.preference.unchecked.en: Current text has not been checked. Use Check and preview; changing text clears the previous preview.
templateAuthor.preference.unchecked.zh-Hans: 当前文本尚未检查。请点击「检查并预览」；修改文本会清除旧预览。

templateAuthor.preference.previewScope.en: Author configuration only. Choices placeholders are retained; this does not play the questionnaire, issue rewards or share tags.
templateAuthor.preference.previewScope.zh-Hans: 这是作者配置预览。保留选择依据占位符，不执行答题、发放奖励或共享标签。

templateAuthor.preference.unknown.en: These fields are preserved in the original text but are not interpreted by this preview:
templateAuthor.preference.unknown.zh-Hans: 以下字段保留在原文中，本预览不解释其语义：

templateAuthor.preference.valid.en: Supported preference rules passed locally. This does not enable publishing.
templateAuthor.preference.valid.zh-Hans: 已支持的偏好规则通过本地检查，此结果不代表已开通发布。

templateAuthor.preference.replaceQuestio.en: Replace the current preference text with the example?
templateAuthor.preference.replaceQuestio.zh-Hans: 用示例替换当前偏好配置文本？

templateAuthor.preference.error.json.en: Invalid JSON. Your current text is retained.
templateAuthor.preference.error.json.zh-Hans: JSON 格式错误，当前文本已保留。

templateAuthor.preference.error.budget.en: Check incomplete: this configuration exceeds the local size, depth, preview or work budget. The original text is retained; it has not been declared invalid by the server.
templateAuthor.preference.error.budget.zh-Hans: 检查未完成：配置超过本地大小、深度、预览或运算预算。原文已保留，这不表示服务端判定其无效。

templateAuthor.preference.error.object.en: An object is required at this field.

templateAuthor.preference.error.array.en: An array is required; questions and dimensions must not be empty.
templateAuthor.preference.error.array.zh-Hans: 此字段必须为数组；题目与维度不能为空。

templateAuthor.preference.error.type.en: This value type is not supported by the local preview. The original text is retained.
templateAuthor.preference.error.type.zh-Hans: 本地预览尚不支持此值类型，原文已保留。

templateAuthor.preference.error.duplicat.en: Keys or dimensions must be unique in their scope.
templateAuthor.preference.error.duplicat.zh-Hans: key 或维度在所属范围内不得重复。

templateAuthor.preference.error.tiebreak.en: Multiple dimensions require a tiebreak question.
templateAuthor.preference.error.tiebreak.zh-Hans: 多个维度必须配置并列取舍题。

templateAuthor.preference.error.results.en: Result keys must match the declared dimensions exactly.
templateAuthor.preference.error.results.zh-Hans: 结果分支 key 必须与已声明维度一一对应。

templateAuthor.preference.error.coupon.en: All results must not use the same coupon.
templateAuthor.preference.error.coupon.zh-Hans: 所有结果不能绑定同一优惠券。

templateAuthor.preference.error.tag.en: Only space_constraints, social_mode, arrival_window and expression_mode tags are supported.

templateAuthor.preference.error.stepType.en: Question type must be single or discard.
templateAuthor.preference.error.stepType.zh-Hans: 题目类型必须为 single 或 discard。

templateAuthor.preference.error.options.en: Each question needs at least two options.
templateAuthor.preference.error.options.zh-Hans: 每道题至少需要两个选项。

templateAuthor.preference.error.score.en: Scores must name declared dimensions and use JSON integers from 0 to 2.
templateAuthor.preference.error.score.zh-Hans: 分值必须对应已声明维度，并使用 0 到 2 的 JSON 整数。

templateAuthor.preference.error.evidence.en: The result body must include {{choices}} as the choice evidence.
templateAuthor.preference.error.evidence.zh-Hans: 结果 body 必须包含 {{choices}} 选择依据。

templateAuthor.preference.error.days.en: nextStepDays must be the JSON integer 7 or 30.
templateAuthor.preference.error.days.zh-Hans: nextStepDays 必须为 JSON 整数 7 或 30。

templateAuthor.preference.error.combinat.en: More than 4096 ordinary combinations: split the questionnaire as required by the server contract.
templateAuthor.preference.error.combinat.zh-Hans: 普通选项组合超过 4096，请按服务端规则拆分题组。

templateAuthor.preference.error.tie.en: At least one tiebreak option can still leave a tie.
templateAuthor.preference.error.tie.zh-Hans: 至少一个并列取舍选项仍可能打平。

templateAuthor.preference.error.reachabl.en: Every declared dimension must be able to win uniquely.
templateAuthor.preference.error.reachabl.zh-Hans: 每个已声明维度都必须可以唯一胜出。
